title: Quenched Syrian Lentil Stew
description: A winey, springy low‑fat stew that soothes hangovers with aromatic star anise and fresh parsley.
instructions: Rinse 1 cup dried lentils under cold water until clear.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 1 diced medium onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Stir in 3 minced garlic cloves and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add 1 diced medium carrot and sauté for 3 minutes.
Pour in 1 cup red wine and let it reduce by half over medium heat.
Add the rinsed lentils, 4 cups low-sodium vegetable broth, 2 whole star anise, 1 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes until lentils are tender.
Remove the star anise sticks and stir in 1 tablespoon lemon juice, adjusting seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley.
